description: This file contains transformation logic for converting messages and request bodies between OpenAI format and Gemini/Vertex AI format, specifically for Gemini version 1.5 or newer. It includes functions to process images, merge messages, handle different content types, and prepare request payloads for API calls within the litellm project.

methods.description: Converts a string detail ('low' or 'high') into a media resolution enum dictionary.

methods.description: Processes an image URL or data into a Gemini-compatible PartType, handling different URL schemes and formats.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_equivalent_key(key: str, available_keys: set)
methods.description: Finds the equivalent key in a set of available keys, considering both snake_case and camelCase variants.

methods.name: bool check_if_part_exists_in_parts( parts: List[PartType], part: PartType, excluded_keys: List[str] = [] )
methods.description: Checks if a specified PartType exists within a list of parts, matching keys case-insensitively.

methods.name: List[ContentType] _gemini_convert_messages_with_history( messages: List[AllMessageValues], model: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Converts a list of messages from OpenAI format to Gemini format, merging content and handling various content types.

methods.description: Transforms message and parameters into a Gemini request body, including handling tools, safety, and other configs.

methods.description: Synchronously prepares a request body for Gemini API call, with caching and context handling.
